Prototype Scenario 01

Ambush at Millroad Ford

A five-round tactics duel against an enemy commander who talks back.

Dusk at the ford. Kael’s raiding column — a dozen spears, two bows, and the Mask himself — is crossing the river to hit the villages beyond it. Your party of four is already in position. He doesn’t know you’re here. Yet.

Your mission: stop the raid. Break his warband, drive him off, take the Mask down — or talk him into walking away. Survive your own cleverness.
BramFighter — your wall
SeraRogue — your knife
TomasCleric — your second wind
EliraWizard — your big answer
Choose his warband

Tilt view This fight also plays on the tilt — turn your phone sideways and the board and war log sit side by side, wide-screen style. You’re in the tilt view — board on the left, war log and your calls on the right. Upright works too; play it your way.

Played it? Tap here — 6 quick taps, you can skip any question.
1 · Call the tacticsEach round, Kael makes his move — then you pick your party’s answer from real battlefield plays.
2 · He adaptsKael remembers your tricks. Burn your big spell early and he’ll fight like it. Taunt him, too — he answers.
3 · Get gradedAfter five rounds, every call you made is scored and named — so you can steal the good ones for your own table.

You are the commander. You call the plays for all four heroes — there is no character to pick or build, and the fight starts the moment you spring the ambush.

Prototype build: Kael is scripted for now — the live-AI version is the next step once we know the fight is fun. New to formations? Grab the free 7 Battlefield Formations guide — he’s about to counter all seven.
